profile.headline: Software Engineer at --
profile.geoLocationName: Sioux Falls, South Dakota, United States
profile.summary:
Flex, Flash & .Net professional experienced in full-cycle software development tasks, including requirement and specification analysis, database/software design, implementation, testing and deployment.

Specialties: Flex 3/4, AS3, Flash Professional, ASP.Net, VB.Net, C#, WPF 3/4, Web Services, HTML, Javascript, CSS, Photoshop, MSSQL 2000/2005, T-SQL, SSRS Development

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designing and maintaining highly interactive and data driven Flex, Flash, AS3 and .Net applications. 
•	Lead our team of .Net developers in the design and development of a new Flash based marketing and analysis application that offers a very responsive and intuitive user interface written entirely in Flex Builder 3. 
•	 Developing, Managing and migrating business processes into a service orientated architecture to support Rich Internet Applications (Flex, Flash and WPF).
•	VB.Net/C# experience developing .Net web based applications, web services and product specific back end/middle tier business & data layer logic.
•	MS SQL 2000/2005 experience in database design and modification to support an expanding and evolving suite of business applications. 
•	SQL experience developing advanced stored procedures to power management and compensation reports.
•	SSRS development experience creating custom MIS reports to satisfy the unique demands of our clients.
•	Experience using source control systems such as Visual Source Safe and Team Foundation Server to maintain, label and document code and version changes across product lines and major release versions.
•	Successfully work in conjunction with the support and quality assurance groups to identify and solve a wide variety of issues while identifying efficient procedures and best practices. 
•	Accustom to working on multiple projects of varying scope across various product lines and technologies.
